Elementary Build Word

Build a longer word from its sounds.

← Choose another game

For teachers and tutors

About Elementary Build Word

The learner builds words from sound tiles, not single letters: "ship" is sh, i, p and "train" is t, r, ai, n. It teaches that two letters can make one sound, which is the key to spelling longer English words.

How to play

  1. Listen to the word.
  2. Put the sound tiles in order.
  3. Check your word.

Play it as a class

Choose Elementary Build Word in the Teacher Game. The projector shows everyone's answers, so mistakes are easy to talk about.
